governing_proposition: Opening architecture is the provisional row-5.12 structural home after capital deployment and before any execution bridge or live inventory state.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed downstream architecture for opening authorisation, placement-readiness evaluation and non-executing handoff after bounded capital deployment. Scope: row 5.12 structure and owned outputs.
relationships_and_distinctions: Contains Downstream Opening, Placement Readiness and Placement Handoff; may expose Broker Protocol context but is not broker execution, live position or inventory architecture.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: capital deployment authority; broker execution architecture; entry order; live inventory
input_authority: Capital Deployment Decision, serial candidate execution material, account/broker readiness context and placement constraints.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Downstream opening authority writes bounded opening/readiness/handoff outputs; current source allocation is alpha evidence only.
lifecycle_transition: Capital-authorised candidate -> bounded opening/readiness structure -> protocol-only handoff.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not form the serial candidate, recompute posture/parallel risk, or resize/re-authorise capital.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not submit broker orders, claim fills, create Live Position state, mutate Inventory Architecture, or perform exit/close.
rationale_and_evidence: The blueprint gives row 5.12 one owner and explicitly prohibits capital sizing and broker-adapter detail; the working blueprint retains thin-seam status.

governing_proposition: Downstream Opening is the bounded authority surface that preserves the authorised opening state after capital deployment without performing placement.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed authority surface that converts admitted capital-authority output and candidate seam truth into an opening snapshot/authorisation state. Scope: opening state before placement readiness and execution.
relationships_and_distinctions: Part of Opening Architecture; feeds Placement Readiness; distinct from Capital Deployment Decision, Placement Handoff, broker submission and Live Position creation.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: capital deployment decision; order opening; position opening; broker placement
input_authority: Capital Deployment Decision and receipt, serial candidate identity/material, preserved placement constraints and opening policy state.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Downstream opening authority is the lawful writer; no broker or inventory writer is admitted by this meaning.
lifecycle_transition: Capital-authorised candidate -> preserved opening authorisation/snapshot -> readiness assessment.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not replace candidate formation, parallel risk, pre-deployment or capital deployment authority.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not submit orders, claim an executed opening, create fill truth or mutate live inventory.
rationale_and_evidence: Ownership core calls these shell outputs and says they cannot be treated as the fresh-capital decision; current policy-freeze fields preserve alpha incompleteness.

governing_proposition: Placement Readiness states whether an authorised opening can proceed to protocol handoff; it never grants order-execution authority.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed non-executing readiness state that evaluates capital-authority output, candidate identity and placement constraints at a protocol-only broker boundary. Scope: ready/blocked result and trace.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes Downstream Opening/capital truth and may emit Placement Handoff only when ready; distinct from Broker Protocol implementation and order authority.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: placement authorisation; order permission; broker ready; execution approval
input_authority: Capital deployment receipt, serial candidate identity, placement constraints and broker-boundary mode.
output_carrier: PlacementReadinessResult with readiness state, blocked reasons, input trace and optional PlacementHandoffMaterial.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Downstream opening authority evaluates and writes the readiness result.
lifecycle_transition: Opening authorisation -> blocked or ready-for-protocol-handoff; no broker state transition occurs.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not recompute capital sizing, alter candidate content or re-run serial/parallel risk decisions.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not open broker execution, submit an order, create a fill or live position, or imply guaranteed placement.
rationale_and_evidence: The contract fixes broker_execution_opened and capital_sizing_recomputed to false; readiness is therefore evidence of a bounded seam, not execution authority.

governing_proposition: Placement Handoff is immutable protocol-only material passed toward a future broker boundary; it is not the broker protocol or a submitted order.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed non-executing carrier containing bounded order-intent preview and trace after Placement Readiness. Scope: adapter-neutral handoff material only.
semantic_owner: downstream opening authority owns handoff construction; a future execution bridge may consume it
relationships_and_distinctions: Output of ready Placement Readiness; consumed by Broker Protocol/execution bridge; distinct from broker adapter, submission, execution receipt, fill and Live Position state.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: broker order; execution request; placement receipt; broker protocol
input_authority: Ready PlacementReadinessResult, authorised capital values, serial candidate identity and placement constraints.
output_carrier: PlacementHandoffMaterial with handoff identity, bounded order-intent preview, broker_protocol_only=true and execution_allowed=false.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Downstream opening authority writes the carrier; future broker/execution owners may read but not reinterpret it.
lifecycle_transition: Ready state -> protocol-only transfer material -> future separately authorised broker boundary.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not modify candidate/capital decisions or invent placement constraints.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not carry broker order IDs, execution/fill receipts, live adapter objects, submitted state or execution permission.
rationale_and_evidence: The contract rejects broker-execution and donor execution-record keys and requires execution_allowed=false; this proves carrier separation, not operational readiness.

governing_proposition: Broker Protocol names the adapter-neutral boundary contract through which a lawful handoff may later be interpreted; it is not a concrete broker adapter or execution event.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed protocol-boundary term for broker-facing message shape, constraints and mode while concrete adapter selection, credentials, submission and receipts remain separately owned. Scope: protocol semantics only.
semantic_owner: execution-bridge/broker-boundary protocol authority; no concrete operational writer admitted here
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes Placement Handoff at a future authorised seam; distinct from the handoff carrier, broker adapter implementation, order placement and execution receipt.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: broker adapter; broker API; order execution; placement handoff
input_authority: PlacementHandoffMaterial plus explicit future adapter/account constraints and separately admitted execution authority.
output_carrier: Protocol-conforming broker request/response carriers only when separately admitted; no current order output is implied.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Protocol authority defines the contract; a selected concrete adapter would lawfully implement it under separate authority.
lifecycle_transition: Protocol-only handoff -> future validated adapter interaction -> separately owned execution receipt/state feedback.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not alter capital/opening/readiness meaning or reinterpret candidate intent.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not imply a configured adapter, credentials, submitted order, acknowledgement, fill or operational broker availability.
rationale_and_evidence: The row-5.12 seam permits broker readiness context but prohibits implementation detail beyond the handoff contract; current working status says broker operation is not established.

governing_proposition: Live Position is the identifier-keyed state of one admitted opened position after execution/state evidence, not an opening authorisation or inventory aggregate.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed per-position state representing one open or lifecycle-tracked position and its declared source evidence after entry. Scope: one position identity and state record.
semantic_owner: position-state authority through its repository contract
relationships_and_distinctions: Contained and read by Inventory Architecture; input to Exit Architecture; distinct from opening/readiness/handoff, inventory aggregate, exit decision and close completion.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: opening authorisation; inventory; order; candidate; close state
input_authority: Execution receipts, fill/state updates and existing position repository state with lawful identity/lineage.
output_carrier: LivePositionState and identifier-keyed position repository record.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Position-state authority is the semantic writer through the repository contract; current process-memory storage is not durable authority.
lifecycle_transition: Lawful execution/state evidence -> open position state -> updates/monitoring -> exit/close consumption -> eventual closure state.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not form candidates, grant capital/opening authority, or reinterpret raw/prepared inputs.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not stand for aggregate inventory, independently place orders, invent fills/exposure, or declare closure without lawful evidence.
rationale_and_evidence: The blueprint allocates per-position state after entry and the ownership supplement separates it from opening and aggregate inventory; alpha process-memory records remain non-durable.

governing_proposition: Inventory Architecture owns the aggregate structure for reading and reconciling live-position, exposure and capital-state truth after entry.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed row-5.13 architecture for identifier-keyed position state, inventory snapshots, declared exposure, capital-state reads and receipts. Scope: aggregate live-inventory structure after entry.
semantic_owner: live inventory authority together with bounded position and capital-state authorities
relationships_and_distinctions: Aggregates Live Position states and lawful capital/exposure facts; supplies Exit Architecture and review/replay; distinct from one position, opening authority and close authority.
lawful_aliases: live inventory architecture; inventory state architecture
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: live position; portfolio strategy; opening architecture; exit architecture
input_authority: Execution/fill-state evidence, position repository records, capital-state records and admitted risk limits.
output_carrier: DownstreamLiveInventorySnapshot, InventoryExposureState, InventoryStateReceipt and bounded state reads.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Live-inventory service may coordinate reads/reconciliation; each repository owner writes only its bounded state and receipts.
lifecycle_transition: Entered/fill evidence -> reconciled per-position state -> aggregate inventory/exposure snapshot -> exit/review consumers.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not form candidates, prepare raw signals, make capital deployment or opening decisions.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not invent valuation/risk policy, directly place orders, hide position mutations or claim durable/replay-complete state without proof.
rationale_and_evidence: The core says inventory outputs do not answer the opening/capital question; the working ownership law limits exposure to declared stored values and records current volatility.

governing_proposition: Exit Architecture owns the bounded policy decision over a live position—hold, trim or close-ready—without performing broker execution or closure mutation.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed row-5.14 decision architecture for evaluating live-position state, policy and risk context into hold, trim-ready, close-ready or blocked exit state. Scope: exit-policy judgement and trace.
semantic_owner: exit and close authority, specifically the exit-policy decision owner
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes Live Position/Inventory Architecture truth; may trigger Close Architecture handoff; distinct from position state, inventory ownership, broker execution and confirmed closure.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: close execution; broker close order; inventory mutation; position state
input_authority: Live inventory receipt and position identity, playbook/exit policy metadata, placement/capital/parallel-risk trace and bounded close policy.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Exit-policy authority writes the decision; it does not write position/inventory or broker state.
lifecycle_transition: Live position -> hold/trim-ready/close-ready/blocked decision -> optional Close Architecture handoff.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not rebuild the candidate, recompute capital sizing, ingest raw sources or override placement/opening history.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not execute broker orders, mutate live inventory or declare a position closed.
rationale_and_evidence: The blueprint allocates exit downstream of live state; the current contract explicitly fixes broker_execution_opened, live_inventory_mutated and capital_sizing_recomputed to false.

governing_proposition: Close Architecture owns the controlled transition from an admitted trim/close-ready decision toward closure handoff, receipt and eventual confirmed position-closure state; it is not the exit decision itself.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed closure architecture for protocol-only close handoff, close receipt/replay evidence and the future separately authorised confirmation of position wind-down. Scope: close transition after Exit Architecture decision.
semantic_owner: exit and close authority, specifically the closure-transition owner; execution and inventory owners retain their own writes
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes trim-ready/close-ready Exit Architecture decision; emits CloseHandoffMaterial and ExitCloseReceipt; confirmed closure later requires broker/execution evidence and lawful Live Position/Inventory updates.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: exit decision; broker close order; live inventory; position closed merely because handoff exists
input_authority: Admitted trim-ready or close-ready exit decision, bounded broker constraints and preserved position/receipt identities.
output_carrier: CloseHandoffMaterial, ExitCloseReceipt and—only under future separate authority—confirmed position-closure state/receipt.
owner_and_lawful_writer: Close authority writes handoff/closure receipts; broker execution owner writes execution evidence; position/inventory authorities apply confirmed state changes.
lifecycle_transition: Exit decision -> protocol-only close handoff -> future broker/execution result -> lawful position/inventory closure update.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not form candidates, resize capital, alter opening/placement history or replace the exit-policy decision.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not imply order submission, fill or closure from handoff alone; must not secretly mutate Live Position or Inventory Architecture.
rationale_and_evidence: Current contracts are intentionally non-executing and replayable. The semantic architecture preserves a later confirmed closure transition without falsely claiming that the alpha handoff performs it.

governing_proposition: The Downstream State-reader Layer owns explicit read-evidence outputs identifying which repo-native capital, position and receipt surfaces were read, the truth class of those reads, and reserved concerns; it does not own open, add, rotate, exit or close decisions.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed downstream evidence layer that reports repo-native capital, position and receipt reads, distinguishes execution-record truth from truthful placeholders, and reserves recommendation-history/every-pass receipt concerns without policy. Scope: downstream state-read evidence only.
semantic_owner: downstream state-reader authority; capital, position and receipt repositories retain semantic and write ownership
relationships_and_distinctions: Reads bounded repo-native state for downstream opening/inventory/review consumers; distinct from Inventory Architecture aggregation, Live Position state, behavioural decisions, Parallel Risk Stage-read observations and replay reconstruction.
lawful_aliases: downstream repo-native state reader; downstream state reader
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: Stage-read State; behavioural decision packet; inventory decision; capital decision; state mutation owner
input_authority: Repo-native capital, position and receipt surfaces through their lawful read contracts, including truthful placeholder status where admitted.
output_carrier: Explicit downstream state-read result identifying surfaces read, truth/placeholder class and reserved non-policy concerns.
owner_and_lawful_writer: The downstream state-reader layer writes only its read-evidence result; capital, position and receipt owners retain state writes and meaning.
lifecycle_transition: Repo-native state/receipt surfaces -> bounded explicit read result -> downstream opening, inventory, review or replay consumer.
prohibited_upstream_authority: Must not form candidates, assess Parallel Risk, decide capital deployment or reinterpret source/stage truth.
prohibited_downstream_authority: Must not decide to open, add, rotate, exit or close; must not mutate capital, positions, inventory or receipts.
rationale_and_evidence: Core lines 183-195 establish this layer, its exact output questions and its prohibited behavioural authority. Ownership is assigned from that proposition, not phrase similarity to Parallel Risk Stage-read State.
